'''Coruscant red wine vinaigrette''' was a [[Salad/Legends|salad]] dressing<ref name="LE" /> originating on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Planetnamia" /> The dressing was made from [[red wine]] and served over fresh greens.<ref name="LE" /> Coruscant red wine vinaigrette was served with fresh greens from [[Ithor/Legends|Ithor]] aboard the luxury [[Hovertrain/Legends|repulsortrain]] [[Gem of Alderaan]]<ref name="GA">{{DoD|The Gem of Alderaan}}</ref> and with fresh [[Barnaba]]n greens at the annual [[Vor-cal Feast]] held aboard the [[House Melantha Orbital Hunting Lodge]] over the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vycinyth]].<ref name="LE" />
